*For the following forecast metrics the created date within the BI environment is now being used instead of the issued date from RIBcx:
This created date is the date that transactions related to the corresponding forms associated with the 3 metrics are loaded within the BI environment.

The created date from the BI environment is being used because there is no relevant date available through the RIBcx endpoints which has the last modified date at a line item level. This is important to captured from a reporting perspective as
any of the line items within the form can change frequently and it is important to track these changes from a point in time analysis perspective.
Issued date from RIBcx only highlights the date a form was first raised and doesn't update when the form undergoes any changes.

In case there is a load failure or delay in the load time in the BI environment then the date for the relevant metrics will be impacted by a day or 2-3 days ( especially during the weekends) which could potentially impact the numbers that are reflected at a particular point of time related to the 3 highlighted metrics above.
